calls.statement:
WITH p3_weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_week
  FROM dim_date
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
)
SELECT 
  fsw.week_ending_date,
  SUM(fsw.closing_value) as weekly_closing_value
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fsw.product_key AND p.is_current = TRUE
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fsw.store_key AND s.is_current = TRUE
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fsw.week_ending_date
WHERE p.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
  AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY fsw.week_ending_date
ORDER BY fsw.week_ending_date

WITH p3_weekly_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    fsw.week_ending_date,
    SUM(fsw.closing_value) as weekly_closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week fsw
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fsw.product_key AND p.is_current = TRUE
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fsw.store_key AND s.is_current = TRUE
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fsw.week_ending_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY fsw.week_ending_date
)
SELECT 
  AVG(weekly_closing_value) as average_closing_value_eur
FROM p3_weekly_totals

WITH p3_weekly_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    fsw.week_ending_date,
    SUM(fsw.closing_value) as weekly_closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week fsw
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fsw.product_key AND p.is_current = TRUE
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fsw.store_key AND s.is_current = TRUE
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = fsw.week_ending_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 9 AND 13
    AND s.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY fsw.week_ending_date
)

  ROUND(AVG(weekly_closing_value), 2) as average_stock_value_eur
FROM p3_weekly_totals
